responsibility: This module implements GCC’s GNU BRIG frontend: a language front end and translation subsystem for HSA BRIG/HSAIL binaries that reads `.brig` input, integrates it with GCC’s language-hook and driver machinery, and lowers BRIG modules, functions, kernels, variables, and instructions into GCC trees/GENERIC plus associated runtime metadata. Its top-level language and build files (`brig-lang.c`, `lang-specs.h`, `lang.opt`, `brigspec.c`, `Make-lang.in`, `config-lang.in`) register BRIG as a GCC language, define options and driver behavior, and connect the `brig1` frontend and runtime library. The `brigfrontend` directory contains the real translator: format/runtime headers describe BRIG records and PHSA metadata, `brig-to-generic` and `brig-function` manage module-wide and per-function state, and a family of instruction/directive handlers covers arithmetic, control flow, memory, atomics, conversions, segments, queues, signals, barriers, labels, variables, and kernel/function declarations. Together these pieces make this module responsible for decoding BRIG 1.x program structure, enforcing BRIG/HSA execution and storage conventions, mapping HSAIL operations and builtins to GCC IR and helper calls, and emitting the kernel-oriented metadata and support hooks needed by the downstream PHSA/HSA runtime environment.
